prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: pixel-art portrait animation atlas, record083 HAPPY eye half
Input images: Image 1: original 64x64 portrait for identity and muted palette; Image 2: 2x2 repeated original upper-half reference grid, exact eye and brow placement
Primary request: Create one clean 2x2 atlas of the same portrait's upper face for HAPPY. Full half-fixed framing, each cell exactly the same upper-half crop and scale as the reference, arranged row-major: open, half closed, fully closed, repeated open. Clearly distinct warm happy expression: subtly lifted relaxed brows and gentle raised lower eye corners, while keeping the brows stationary and identical across all four blink phases. Preserve original eye spacing, gray-blue iris size and horizontal position under descending lids; no iris in fully closed pose. The first and fourth open poses must match.
Style/medium: faithful low-resolution pixel art matching the source, soft muted contrast, original brown skin and hair, gray-blue irises
Composition/framing: 2x2 grid, four equal 64:35 aspect-ratio cells, no gutters, no labels, no added border; same crop and pixel-scale impression as reference
Constraints: Edit only eyelids/eyes and emotion-specific brow expression. Keep face identity and feature placement. Happy warmth must be visible yet subtle, distinct from neutral. Keep each eye natural and coherent at native pixel scale.
Avoid: cartoon grin cues in eyes, exaggerated arches, moving or shrinking irises, mismatched gaze, white flashes, bright highlights, thick near-black brow bars, orange skin halos, any text or watermark.
